name: M15 rolling-median cross continuation and fade screening batch

source_references.citation: Rosa (2022), Understanding Intraday Momentum Strategies, Journal of Futures Markets
source_references.supports: Registered abstract-level contrary context: an adjacent intraday-momentum strategy disappears out of sample. It does not establish a rolling-median FX rule or profitability.

research.evidence_summary: No direct source supports this M15 rolling-median cross rule. Adjacent intraday-momentum evidence is contrary and the existing I-58 raw-price mean-reversion territory is adverse/parked, so this is a compact speculative falsification.

feasibility.rationale: Only supported M1 OHLC, causal completed M15 bars, signal-close fills, one fixed ATR stop and same-day exits are required; V2 still must confirm isolated result transport.

market.session: Weekday signals from completed M15 bars ending 09:00 through 13:45 Europe/London; every exit due no later than 15:00

data.frequency: Interval-start M1 OHLC aggregated into Europe/London wall-clock M15 intervals
data.minimum_history: Fixed V2 development data only, with 98 valid observed M15 closes through signal t; elapsed gaps do not reset ATR, but every median/event bar t-L through t must be physically adjacent
preprocessing: Treat M1 timestamp ts as [ts,ts+1 minute) and require exactly 15 consecutive unique valid M1 candles per London M15 bar
Valid OHLC is finite and positive with high>=max(open,close), low<=min(open,close), high>=low; duplicates invalidate aggregation
Compute observed-sequence TR from previous observed close, seed Wilder ATR(96) from the first 96 valid TRs, recur ATR_i=(95*ATR_{i-1}+TR_i)/96, and freeze through t-1
Use IANA Europe/London rules and canonical UTC storage
dependencies: V2 resolved signal-time spread, commission and slippage
limitations: A rolling price median has no stationarity guarantee
Crosses may be frequent bid-ask noise
Six correlated symbols and eight cells are not independent trials

hypothesis.behavior: A completed close crossing a causally frozen rolling median may continue as a location/regime shift or fade as a transient threshold excursion.
hypothesis.mechanism: Follow-through may reflect persistent directional flow through a local reference level; fading may reflect noisy oscillation around a nonstationary center.
works_when: The frozen median captures a locally relevant price reference
One response sign survives both lookbacks and adjacent holds after costs
fails_when: Median crossings are random and over-frequent
The price level drifts too quickly to be a center
falsifiable_predictions: A response-mode center and at least one exact neighbor have positive net R
The center is positive in both UTC halves and at least three symbols
The center and required neighbor survive doubled costs and five-date removal

definitions.name: atr96_prior
definitions.formula: Wilder ATR(96) through t-1 over valid observed true ranges
definitions.timing: Frozen before signal bar t; require finite and positive

definitions.name: median_L_prior
definitions.formula: median of closes t-L through t-1; because L is even, arithmetic mean of the two middle sorted closes

definitions.name: cross_direction
definitions.formula: +1 when close_{t-1}<=median_L_prior and close_t>median_L_prior; -1 when close_{t-1}>=median_L_prior and close_t<median_L_prior; otherwise no event
definitions.timing: Strict current-bar crossing at completed close; prior equality is eligible

definitions.name: trade_side
definitions.formula: cross_direction for FOLLOW_CROSS and -cross_direction for FADE_CROSS
definitions.timing: Mechanical mapping at completed signal close

entries.long_condition: eligible completed t AND ((cross_direction=+1 AND response_mode=FOLLOW_CROSS) OR (cross_direction=-1 AND response_mode=FADE_CROSS)) AND finite atr96_prior>0 AND cell flat
entries.short_condition: eligible completed t AND ((cross_direction=-1 AND response_mode=FOLLOW_CROSS) OR (cross_direction=+1 AND response_mode=FADE_CROSS)) AND finite atr96_prior>0 AND cell flat
entries.signal_time: Close of a London M15 interval ending 09:00 through 13:45 on a weekday when signal time plus holding_minutes is no later than 15:00
entries.execution_details: Enter at the final M1 chart/bid close of completed M15 bar t; V2 applies resolved or fixed-fallback spread, commission and slippage. The entry candle cannot trigger the new stop; management begins next M1.
entries.order_type: Market order at supported signal-close execution
restrictions: One open position per symbol per cell
No pyramiding or reset from overlapping crosses
Every bar t-L through t is physically adjacent
Current close equality to median is no event

exits.stop_loss: Long bid-chart stop=signal_close_bid-atr96_prior; short bid-chart stop=signal_close_bid+atr96_prior. Long triggers on bid, short on executable ask; adverse gaps fill at V2's worse executable open with all costs.
exits.time_exit: Exit at the M1 close ending exactly signal_time plus holding_minutes; invalid M1 in (entry_time,due_exit_time] fails affected cells; on a valid due bar STOP_LOSS precedes TIME_EXIT
exits.maximum_holding: At most 60 minutes and never after 15:00 Europe/London
exits.end_of_session: No entry may mature after 15:00 London; post-entry defects fail only affected cells

risk.position_sizing: Each cell owns an isolated portfolio. Within a cell, same-timestamp symbols size from one common pre-entry equity snapshot so chart stop risk is 0.25% before costs; no state crosses cells.
risk.gross_exposure_limit: Per cell at most six symbols and 1.50% aggregate initial stop risk; no cap shared across eight portfolios
risk.leverage: Use lower of stop-risk size and V2 limits; skip unrepresentable size
risk.concurrent_positions: Within each cell one per symbol and six total; all eight cells have independent position/equity/exposure/overlap/failure state

experiment.baseline: median_lookback=8, response_mode=FOLLOW_CROSS, holding_minutes=60, fixed stop=1 ATR
robustness_tests: Report all eight cells and retain complete contemporaneous breadth ledger
Report every symbol and UTC-midpoint development half; midpoint close belongs to first half
Double spread, commission and slippage individually
For each mode center L=8/hold=60 remove its five best normal-cost London dates from center and exact neighbors L=16 and hold=30; require retained normal/doubled net R positive
For each center/neighbor use eligible London weekdays including zeros and 10000 circular five-date block-bootstrap resamples with seed 2026012; center normal-cost lower bound must exceed zero
A mode advances only if center and at least one of L=16 or hold=30 passes every gate
costs: Use resolved or frozen-fallback spread, commission and slippage at every fill
Double each cost component for stress
No swap because exits precede 15:00 London
benchmarks: Opposite response mode on identical crossings
experiment.multiple_testing: Count all 304 selectable R007-R012 cells, R008's two diagnostics, and every named legacy trial including I-58/raw-price mean-reversion and intraday-momentum variants. Cross-batch promotion uses the full ledger. Incomplete historical IDs prohibit confirmation; no best-cell/family rescue.
rejection_criteria: Reject a mode unless center and at least one exact neighbor are positive after normal/doubled costs
Reject if center is non-positive in either UTC half or fewer than three symbols are positive in each half
Reject if center has fewer than 300 pooled trades
Reject if five-date removal makes center or required neighbor non-positive
Reject if center bootstrap lower bound is not above zero
Reject promotion if required cells fail data integrity
Never access final holdout without explicit authorization for a separately frozen promoted version

pseudocode: Build valid London M15 bars causally.
Freeze sorted-close medians for L=8/16 before t.
Require prior close on/equivalent side and current close strictly across median; map follow/fade.
Enter flat cells at signal close; from next M1 process stop before due exit and fail only affected cells on defects.
Publish eight cells, neighbors, robustness and full breadth-ledger identities.
required_libraries: existing V2 candle, timezone, cost, fill and R-accounting components
edge_cases: prior equality qualifies but current equality does not
event-window gap suppresses signal while elapsed gaps remain in ATR
adverse gap uses worse executable open
implementation.computational_requirements: One causal pass per symbol with shared rolling features and isolated eight-cell portfolios.
known_backtester_gaps: Queue waits for V2 M15/fill/cell-state compatibility and confirmation of required result rows
